subject: [PATCH v8 06/30] s390: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds PMD swap-exclusive helpers for the s390 architecture, allowing a PMD-mapped anonymous THP to be kept mapped across a swap round-trip by introducing an exclusive bit in the RSTE swap layout. This is necessary because on s390, a swap PMD is not just a swap PTE in disguise, but has its own unique layout. The patch introduces new macros and functions to set and clear this exclusive bit, enabling more efficient handling of swap operations on s390 systems.
